title: Console copilot answer
description: One turn's answer. The console reviews it against the person's own permissions before the person sees it.

text.description: The answer in plain sentences, short paragraphs separated by a blank line. No Markdown, no HTML.

proposals.description: What the console opens for the person to review. Nothing runs until the person confirms it there.

kind.description: filter: a list with a filter; create: a create form, filled; action: a verb's form on one resource, filled; open: a console page.

label.description: What the person reads on the button, in a few words.

service.description: The service of the type, as request.types has it.

type.description: The type, as request.types has it.

q.description: Words to search for that the other fields cannot say.

drift.description: true: only resources that drifted; false: only those that did not.

tags.description: Tag name to value; an empty value means the resource has the tag.

input.description: Fields of the form, filled only with what the person said.

missing.description: Required fields of the form still empty.

wfrn.description: For an action: the wfrn of the resource, from request.resources or request.subject.

verb.description: For an action: a verb of the type's verbs in request.types.

explanation.description: For an explain turn: the resource of request.subject, in plain words.

failure.description: For a failure turn: why the job of request.failure failed and what to change before retrying it.

title.description: What went wrong, in a few words.

fix.description: What to change before retrying, in plain sentences.

input.description: Only fields of request.failure.inputForm whose values the retry should change.

refused.description: true when you cannot or should not answer.

reason.description: Why you did not answer, in one sentence.
